channel.title: LoomSci - Matter Science
channel.description: Latest Matter Science articles from LoomSci

item.title: The Speed of Light's Shadow: Measuring Laser Beams at 100 MHz
item.description: By transforming laser beam spatial profiles into high-speed temporal signals, FLASH achieves beam quality measurement at 100 million frames per second.

item.title: When Turbulence Learns to Speak the Language of Quarks
item.description: A universal loop-space diffusion equation unites the chaotic swirl of turbulence with the quantum confinement of quarks, bridging two great mysteries of physics.

item.title: Connecting Localization and Gravity: The Hidden Transition in Rotated Space
item.description: A simple rotation of quantum operators reveals a hidden localization transition, where wavefunctions become multifractal and the lattice mirrors a curved spacetime.

item.title: The Hidden Courtyard Where Electrons Turn into Molecules
item.description: Inside a four-layer cuprate, pristine inner copper-oxygen planes shield electrons from disorder, enabling them to pair so strongly they behave as bosonic molecules, driving a BCS-to-BEC crossover.

item.title: The AI That Learned to Doubt Its Own Answers
item.description: An AI swarm of specialized agents learns from its own failures to map catalytic reactions, turning stumbles into breakthroughs in autonomous scientific discovery.

item.title: The Power Law Measuring Quantum Frustration
item.description: A transformer's computational cost to approximate a quantum state follows a clean power law, whose exponent reveals the strength of geometric frustration in spin systems.

item.title: How a Lattice Learned to Weave Non‑Abelian Loops
item.description: A lattice of qubit-like spins gives rise to non-Abelian loops whose braiding and fusion mirror a continuum field theory.

item.title: When a Vibration Learns to Spin
item.description: Lattice vibrations in metallic strontium titanate develop chirality and couple to electron spins, creating a hybrid mode with a magnetic personality.
